name: Garlic-Parmesan Ribeye with Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Carrots

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Mash together with the back of a spoon and stir to combine the garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut steak into portions and spread garlic oil on both sides; set aside on a plate to marinate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry Brussels sprouts. Using a clean cutting board, trim ends and halve the sprouts; divide between two baking sheet pans.
Wash, dry, peel, trim, and cut carrots crosswise into ½-inch rounds; add to the baking sheets with the Brussels sprouts.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp basil, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add steaks and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side.
While the steaks cook, finely grate Parmesan.
When the steaks are done, transfer to a clean plate and top with the Parmesan. Loosely cover with aluminum foil and let rest, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and steaks between plates. Enjoy!
